record.original_question: Let (X, X, µ, T) be a system and f, g, h ∈ L∞(µ). If C(n) := ∫ f · T^n g · T^(2n) h dµ, is the sequence (C(n)) an approximate integral combination of generalized 2-step nilsequences?

evidence.quote: Special Case of Problem 1. Let (X, X , µ, T) be a system and f, g, h ∈ L∞(µ). Is it true that the sequence (C(n)) defined by C(n) := ∫ f · T^n g · T^2n h dµ, n ∈ N, is an (approximate) integral combination of generalized 2-step nilsequences?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu,T)$ be a measure-preserving system, where $T:X\to X$ is an invertible measure-preserving transformation of the probability space $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu)$. For $f,g,h\in L^\infty(\mu)$, define the 3-term correlation sequence
$$C(n) \;=\; \int_X f\cdot (T^n g)\cdot (T^{2n} h)\,d\mu, \qquad n\in\mathbb{N}.$$

A basic 2-step nilsequence is a sequence of the form $(F(a^n\Gamma))_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$, where $G/\Gamma$ is a 2-step nilmanifold (i.e., $G$ is a 2-step nilpotent Lie group and $\Gamma\le G$ is a discrete cocompact subgroup), $a\in G$, and $F:G/\Gamma\to\mathbb{C}$ is continuous. A generalized 2-step nilsequence is a uniform limit of basic 2-step nilsequences.

Determine whether the following holds: for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exist finitely many generalized 2-step nilsequences $\psi_1,\dots,\psi_k$ and integers $c_1,\dots,c_k\in\mathbb{Z}$ such that
$$\limsup_{N\to\infty}\;\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\Bigl|\,C(n)\;-\;\sum_{j=1}^{k} c_j\,\psi_j(n)\Bigr| \;<\;\varepsilon.$$

That is, is $(C(n))_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ an approximate integral combination of generalized 2-step nilsequences?
artifact.category_tag: Ergodic multiple correlation sequences and nilsequences
artifact.status_search_result: For a single measure-preserving transformation, decomposition results (Bergelson–Host–Kra; Frantzikinakis) show that the 3-term correlation sequence $C(n)$ can be written as a 2-step nilsequence plus an error term small in uniform density, which is closely related to but slightly weaker than an "approximate integral combination of generalized 2-step nilsequences." Generalizations to commuting transformations and along primes have appeared (Frantzikinakis 2015 Inventiones; Frantzikinakis–Host; Koutsogiannis–Le–Moreira–Richter 2020), and recent work (e.g., 2504.07038, 2026) further refines such decompositions. The exact integral-combination formulation does not appear to have a definitive published affirmative resolution in full generality; the problem is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Multiple correlation sequences and nilsequences
status_evidence.snippet: any such correlation sequence is the sum of a nilsequence and an error term that is small in uniform density; this was previously known only for measure preserving actions of a single transformation
status_evidence.claim: The single-transformation case of a related decomposition (nilsequence plus uniform-density-small error) was known prior to 2014.

status_evidence.title: Structured extensions and multi-correlation sequences
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work continues to refine decomposition statements for multi-correlation sequences.
status_evidence.claim: The decomposition problem and its variants remain an active topic, with continued refinements.

status_evidence.title: A decomposition of multicorrelation sequences for commuting transformations along primes
status_evidence.snippet: Decomposition of multicorrelation sequences along primes for commuting transformations.
status_evidence.claim: Partial decomposition results are known in various extended settings.
